fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the Clan touman fills the garrison and screening roles that battle armor and BattleMech forces cannot efficiently sustain across dozens of occupied worlds. Motorized Points ride light vehicles or motorcycles that provide faster movement than foot infantry without the heavier logistical requirements of fully mechanized formations. They trade protection for speed, making them effective as screening forces and rapid-response elements but vulnerable when caught in sustained engagements. Carrying lighter ballistic weapons that trade stopping power for reduced weight and easier handling, these Points favor speed and endurance over raw firepower.
